request.query: Infimum of a nonempty finite set is less than c iff some member is less than c

items.name: Finset.inf'_lt_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [inst : LinearOrder α] {s : Finset ι} (H : s.Nonempty) {f : ι → α} {a : α},
  s.inf' H f < a ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, f i < a

items.name: Finset.inf_le_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : OrderTop α] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α} {a : α},
  a < ⊤ → (s.inf f ≤ a ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, f b ≤ a)

items.name: Finset.inf'_le_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [inst : LinearOrder α] {s : Finset ι} (H : s.Nonempty) {f : ι → α} {a : α},
  s.inf' H f ≤ a ↔ ∃ i ∈ s, f i ≤ a

items.name: iInf_lt_iff
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Sort u_4} [inst : CompleteLinearOrder α] {a : α} {f : ι → α}, iInf f < a ↔ ∃ i, f i < a

items.name: ciInf_lt_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Sort u_4} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] {a : α} [Nonempty ι] {f : ι → α},
  BddBelow (Set.range f) → (iInf f < a ↔ ∃ i, f i < a)

items.name: Finset.le_inf'_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : SemilatticeInf α] {s : Finset β} (H : s.Nonempty) (f : β → α) {a : α},
  a ≤ s.inf' H f ↔ ∀ b ∈ s, a ≤ f b

items.name: Finset.inf'_le
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : SemilatticeInf α] {s : Finset β} (f : β → α) {b : β} (h : b ∈ s),
  s.inf' ⋯ f ≤ f b

items.name: Finset.inf_lt_iff
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_5} [inst : LinearOrder α] [inst_1 : OrderTop α] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → α} {a : α},
  s.inf f < a ↔ ∃ b ∈ s, f b < a
